name: Venture X Business

apr.notes: Purchase APR not stated on product page. Card is designed to be paid in full; you have the option to carry over a portion of your balance with interest if needed.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees. Pay zero foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside of the United States.

base_rate.description: Earn unlimited 2X miles on every purchase, everywhere, no limits or category restrictions.

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem miles through travel site, get reimbursed for travel expenses, or transfer miles to 15+ partners.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 150,000 bonus miles when you spend $30,000 in the first 3 months, which is equal to $1,500 in travel.

benefits.title: $300 annual travel credit
benefits.description: Receive an annual $300 credit for bookings through Capital One Business Travel.

benefits.title: 10,000 bonus miles every year
benefits.description: You'll also get 10,000 bonus miles every year, starting on your first anniversary.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: Pay zero foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside of the United States.

benefits.title: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck credit
benefits.description: Receive up to a $120 statement credit on Global Entry or TSA PreCheck®.

benefits.title: Airport lounge access
benefits.description: Explore a network of 1,300+ lounges worldwide. Access to Capital One Lounges and Landing, and Priority Pass.

benefits.title: Premier Collection
benefits.description: Elevate your stay at luxury hotels, resorts and vacation rentals from the Premier Collection with a $100 experience credit and other premium benefits on every booking.

benefits.title: Hertz President's Circle status
benefits.description: Skip the counter at select locations, enjoy a wider selection of rental cars and more, just for being a Venture X Business cardholder.

benefits.title: Capital One Business Travel
benefits.description: Save time and money with complimentary access to an all-in-one business travel management solution.

benefits.title: $0 fraud liability
benefits.description: If your card is lost or stolen, you can get an emergency replacement and a cash advance.

benefits.title: Free employee and virtual cards
benefits.description: Empower your team to make purchases while earning rewards on their transactions, with free employee and virtual cards.

benefits.title: Extended warranty
benefits.description: Get free additional warranty and protection on eligible items you purchase with your card.

benefits.title: Expense Management
benefits.description: You and your employees can quickly add expense details—including receipts and notes—for faster reporting.

notes: Verified against official Capital One product page on 2026-07-24. Purchase APR not stated on page — preserved as null. Corrected name from 'Venture X Business Card' to 'Venture X Business' per page heading.
